recorded_topology_interpretation.limits: Counts above are prior authenticated/public receipt observations, not recomputed here. Fewer bad pairs globally does not prevent a worse local junction. recorded_topology_interpretation.attribution_rule: An inspected witness may demonstrate its own endpoint IDs, full incident face occurrences, original incidence class and output geometry. It cannot alone attribute all116786 pairs to the same mechanism or recover which precise collapses produced them.

colour_interpolation.equation: At an interior point, C_linear(p)=sum_i bary_i(p)*decode(native_byte[source_id_i]); encoded_RGB=IEC_encode(C_linear(p)).
colour_interpolation.reason: Exact retained bytes fix each retained vertex sample. Changing the triangle's source-ID triple changes the three samples, the spanned surface and the barycentric weights. The resulting interior colour can therefore differ from both the original piecewise-linear surface colour and the genuine spatial source field without any byte having changed.
colour_interpolation.controls: A spatial attribution probe must freeze candidate world positions independently of output colours, evaluate the same genuine original field at those positions, report native-byte interpolation and scalar residuals separately, retain zero-support evidence, and distinguish new-field probes from prior query replay. No colour fitting or material adjustment follows from this diagnostic.

next_small_patch_constraints: Any future reduction needs separate authorization and a frozen part/topology rule, scope, ratio/error, query seeds, acceptance and resource plan. This attribution run authorizes no second candidate.

Keep the master and rejected candidate immutable. Preserve exact original vertex/face IDs and an explicit compaction map; no coordinate weld, face-fan duplication, pruning or hidden repair may manufacture apparent success.

A topology witness must count all face occurrences incident to the chosen endpoint pair, including duplicates and winding; show the original incidence category and full bounded local context. A truncated patch boundary must not hide incident faces or be mistaken for a real asset boundary.

Semantic parts are not established by207 vertex-connected labels. If a later part-aware method separates sheets or materials inside one component, state and test that rule explicitly; preserve true shared interfaces without bridging disconnected source components or erasing selected isolated components.

Require no new incidence>2 endpoint pair and no local incidence growth at protected existing junctions, no new oriented duplicates or repeated-index/zero-area/nonfinite triangles, and preserve oriented unchanged triples. Check selected component lineage and patch boundaries explicitly.

Freeze geometry, silhouette and known thin-foliage observations before a future patch candidate. Retain source gates0.005/0.01/0.03 diagonal and0.98 IoU/0.99 depth-aware visible-foliage retention where applicable; disclose excluded parts. A local pass cannot certify the full asset or every leaf.

Exact native-byte transfer is necessary but insufficient. Validate fixed candidate interior RGB against authentic field values in each included original region using0.02/0.05/0.15 and separate unchanged metallic/roughness/OPAQUE-alpha RMSE0.02; missing support fails. Do not fit colours or loosen a gate after observing output.

Keep bounded CPU supervision, fixed resource floors, exact GO after owned Job attachment, source preservation, exclusive outputs, natural completion and separate execution/quality verdicts. A failed conservative distance upper bound alone remains BLOCKED rather than proof of actual damage.
